title: Arkansas's 4th Congressional District Election, 2026
description: The 2026 election for Arkansas's 4th Congressional District will be held on November 3, 2026, with the general election featuring Republican incumbent Bruce Westerman facing Democratic nominee James 'Rus' Russell. Arkansas's four U.S. House seats have been held by Republicans since 2013, and the 4th District is rated as Solidly Republican by nonpartisan election forecasters. Westerman, a forester who chairs the House Natural Resources Committee, is seeking a seventh term, while Russell, a mental health advocate and small business owner, won the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026. The district covers parts of Pulaski and Sebastian counties and the entirety of 31 other counties across southern and western Arkansas.
polling_note: No publicly available opinion polls were found for this specific race as of mid-2026. The race is rated 'Solid R' or 'Safe R' by Cook Political Report, Inside Elections, and Sabato's Crystal Ball.

candidates.name: Bruce Westerman
candidates.summary: Bruce Westerman is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Arkansas's 4th Congressional District, first elected in 2014. He chairs the House Natural Resources Committee and previously served as Majority Leader of the Arkansas House of Representatives. A forester and engineer by training, Westerman is seeking a seventh term in Congress.

candidates.name: James Russell
candidates.summary: James 'Rus' Russell is the Democratic nominee for Arkansas's 4th Congressional District, having won the March 3, 2026 primary with 53% of the vote. He is a mental health advocate and small business owner who co-owns an outpatient mental health practice in Little Rock with his wife. Russell previously ran for Governor of Arkansas in 2022 and has a background in healthcare credentialing and medical staff coordination.
